company_name: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd.

inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero filer: no share-based payment line in any FY2017-FY2025 CAS cash-flow statement or equity note (financial-parser adjudication: NULL, not zero). State-controlled issuer with no equity-incentive scheme in force; SBC rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow for repurchases recorded as 0 in the Metrics KPI table. In H1 2026 the company repurchased 27,245,000 H shares (interim report line 3195), cancelling 10,245,600 on 12 May 2026 and 16,999,400 on 13 July 2026; the cash left in H1 2026 and the cancellations are already reflected in the 1,330.70M count used here. Count held flat thereafter (SBC-zero, so no dilution to offset).
inputs.share_count_basis: Issued ordinary shares after the 13 July 2026 cancellation: 1,347,702,812 at 30 June 2026 (interim report share-capital table, line 5027) less 16,999,400 treasury H shares cancelled 13 July 2026 (line 5048) = 1,330,703,412. Cross-check: dividends payable CNY 904.9M at 30 June 2026 / CNY 0.68 final DPS = 1,330.7M shares. No convertibles, options or RSUs exist, so basic = fully diluted. Weighted-average count in the Metrics CSV (1,366.6M for H1 2026) is higher only because the cancellations fell mid-period.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows are CNY (RMB); the H share quotes in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate is model->quote: 1 CNY = 1.1747 HKD, from Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8513 at 2026-10-22 (1/0.8513). Direction check: the level is consistent with the ~0.85 HKD/CNY cross (USD/CNY ~6.6 against the 7.75-7.85 HKD peg) that has held through 2025-26. Dual-listing parity: the A share 688187.SS closed CNY 47.42 on 2026-10-22, equivalent to HK$55.70; the H share at HK$26.66 (CNY 22.70) therefore trades at a 52% discount to the A share (A/H premium ~109%). That gap is the usual STAR-Market A/H premium, not an fx-direction error, and it is a finding in its own right: the base-case IV below lands almost exactly on the A-share price. All per-share values are computed in CNY and converted at 1.1747; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price; *_cny twins carry the model currency.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T08:08:34Z regular HKEX close (not after-hours); 52-week range 26.44-46.50, so the price sits on the 52-week low
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10Y CGB ~1.8% risk-free, equity risk premium ~6.5% x beta ~1.1 gives ~9.0% cost of equity; debt is negligible (CNY 164M against CNY 5.0bn cash) so WACC ~= cost of equity. 0.5pp added for the H-share holder's SOE governance / connected-party exposure (CRRC Group caps of CNY 16.3-27.5bn/yr of sales, trade-secrecy non-disclosure of customers), giving 9.5%. That premium lives in the rate and ONLY in the rate: the same 9.5% is used in all three scenarios, and cyclicality, receivables risk and the capex overhang are carried in the scenario flows and weights, so risk is charged once.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. Lease liabilities (CNY 271.2M non-current + 135.1M current at 30 June 2026) are EXCLUDED from total_debt; instead the full lease cash cost (principal ~CNY 150M, approximated by FY2025 right-of-use depreciation of CNY 150.2M, plus ~CNY 15M interest) is charged inside EBIT through lease_cost_pct_path at 0.6% of revenue. da_pct_path is therefore D&A EX right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 total D&A CNY 1,553.9M (fixed assets 1,140.5 + intangibles 255.8 + ROU 150.2 + long-term prepaid 7.3; annual report line 20825-20828) less ROU 150.2 = CNY 1,403.7M = 4.9% of revenue, stepping up to 5.3-5.6% as the SiC/IGBT fabs transfer from CIP to fixed assets (fixed-asset depreciation already rose 34% in FY2025).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (the component build ties to consolidated NOPAT: FY0 check below), so non-controlling interests are deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book, CNY 3,494.9M at 30 June 2026. The NCI is mostly the strategic-investor minority in CRRC Times Semiconductor (CNY 4,543M of minority capital contributions in FY2024, annual report cash-flow statement), injected at a 2024 valuation, so book is a reasonable floor for its claim. FY0 tie-out: revenue 28,702.7 x 21.3% owner EBITDA = 6,114 less lease 172 less D&A ex-ROU 1,404 = EBIT 4,538, less 13% cash tax = NOPAT ~3,950, against reported consolidated net income 4,307.0 (4,096.5 attributable + 210.5 NCI) less ~270 of after-tax interest income = ~4,037. Ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (dcf-methods routing row 2: non-US cyclical industrial, with the adaptations for dual currency, leases, NCI, matching assets and SBC-zero). Operating company (rail traction systems ~55% of revenue, power semiconductors / NEV electric drive / new-energy converters / marine ~45%); not a bank, REIT or holdco. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry, no prior DCF). OWNER-FCF BASE: reported FCF FY2025 = OCF 3,964.7 - fixed-asset capex 4,009.8 = -45.0; less interest income 305.3 (net cash plus deposits ~CNY 14bn is >> the FCF base, so the cash pile would otherwise be counted twice) = owner FCF -350.3. Owner FCF has been NEGATIVE for three consecutive years (FY2023 -475, FY2024 -375, FY2025 -350) on CNY 3-4bn of profit: the gap is (i) fab capex of 13.6-14.0% of revenue versus a historical 5-6% and (ii) working-capital absorption of ~30-50% of each year's revenue increase (receivables and bills from state customers; AR 14.6bn + receivables financing 2.4bn + bills 2.7bn at June 2026). Neither is carried forward flat: capex is ramped down from 11% as the two power-device projects complete (Yixing 92% spent of a CNY 6.77bn budget; second project 50% of CNY 5.29bn; H1 2026 capex already 9.0% of revenue, CIP fell 3,463 -> 2,410), and working capital is modelled as a NEGATIVE capture on the revenue CHANGE (-30% base, -25% bull, -40% bear), so the drag shrinks mechanically as growth slows. EBITDA MARGIN: company-defined EBITDA FY2025 6,453.7 (22.5%) includes interest and investment income; owner EBITDA strips ~305M interest and ~60M structured-deposit returns = ~21.3%, flat on FY2024 (21.3%). H1 2026 attributable profit grew 2.4% on revenue +7.0%, so FY2026 is set at 21.0%. CASH TAX: current tax FY2025 595.7M on PBT 4,871.6 (12.2%; 13.0% on EBIT ex interest) reflects the 15% high-tech rate plus R&D super-deductions; ramped to 15% over five years. MATCHING-ASSET RULE: every stripped income stream has its asset in the bridge: cash 5,015.0 (in net_debt), large-denomination CDs 7,259.0 and non-current time deposits 718.7 (note VII.21, interim line ~ note 21), held-for-trading structured deposits 1,500.6, other equity-instrument investments 285.1 (FY2025 value; H1 2026 not re-disclosed). GUIDANCE: none numeric; management targets 'profitability enhancement' and the 2026-28 CRRC Group connected-transaction caps (sales caps CNY 16.3bn / 21.1bn / 27.5bn) imply strong related-party volume growth but are caps, not forecasts. PRICE: on the 52-week low; the interim dividend of CNY 0.46/share declared 19 Aug 2026 is not deducted because its payment date could not be confirmed from the interim report; if it was paid before 2026-10-22 the bridge is ~CNY 612M (CNY 0.46/share, HK$0.54) too generous.

equity_bridge.note: Interim 2026 note VII.21 'Large-denomination certificates of deposit' CNY 7,259,014,012 at 30 June 2026 (FY2025: 6,700.7). Interest-bearing; its income is stripped from the flows via interest_income, so the asset enters the bridge at carrying value.
Interim 2026 note VII.21 'Time deposits' CNY 718,666,712 at 30 June 2026 (FY2025: 2,762.7; the fall is maturities reinvested in CDs and short-term deposits inside cash).

Interim 2026 balance sheet line 5409, CNY 1,500,562,247 at 30 June 2026; principal-protected structured deposits (annual report entrusted-wealth-management table, lines 10533-10535). Their returns sit in investment income, which the 21.3% owner-EBITDA anchor excludes.

equity_bridge.note: FY2025 balance sheet line 11708, CNY 285,062,700; dividend income excluded from owner EBITDA. H1 2026 value not separately re-disclosed; FY2025 carried.

equity_bridge.note: Interim 2026 'Dividends payable' CNY 904,878,320 at 30 June 2026 = CNY 0.68 x 1,330.7M shares, approved June 2026 and paid in July 2026. The 30 June cash balance pre-dates the payment while the 2026-10-22 price is ex that dividend, so it is deducted.
Interim 2026 balance sheet line 5513, CNY 3,494,938,532 at 30 June 2026. Deducted once here; flows are consolidated (see nci_treatment).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2026 run-rate (H1 2026 revenue +7.0%, Q1 +12.5%, Q2 ~+3%) bracketed by the 7.2% equity CAGR ex-IPO and the 12.4% five-year revenue CAGR; equity CAGR is not used mechanically because the 2021 STAR-Market IPO inflates it
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 12.2% exceeds EPS 5yr CAGR 7.2% by ~70%: the 2021 A-share IPO raised ~CNY 7.5bn of equity and lifted the share count from 1,175.5M to 1,416.2M, so book value grew from issuance, not retention, while EPS was diluted by the same issuance. Revenue 3yr (16.6%) vs 5yr (12.4%) also diverge because FY2020-21 were flat (rail capex trough, revenue 16.0bn -> 15.1bn) before the FY2023-25 emerging-equipment ramp.
historical_growth.notes: CAGR endpoints: revenue FY2020 16,033.9 -> FY2025 28,702.7 (5yr), FY2022 18,126.1 -> FY2025 (3yr); EPS FY2020 2.11 -> FY2025 2.99, FY2022 1.80 -> 2.99; equity FY2020 23,852.5 -> FY2025 42,486.9 (5yr), FY2023 36,998.1 -> FY2025 (2yr, labelled 3yr because FY2022 balance-sheet lines are absent from the five-year summary). Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income, SBC = 0): FY2017 1,007; FY2018 3,047; FY2019 1,059; FY2020 -150; FY2021 1,081; FY2023 -475; FY2024 -375; FY2025 -350. Both CAGR endpoints are negative so the owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (null) rather than a misleading number. Reported FCF over the same years was 1,035 / 3,087 / 1,087 / -108 / 1,176 / -215 / -89 / -45: interest income has grown from 3% to 7x the reported FCF base, i.e. essentially all of the reported FCF of FY2023-25 was interest on the cash pile, not operating cash generation.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue +8% (H1 +7.0%; rail +9.7%, automotive electric drive +46%, semis/new-energy slowing), decelerating to 3% by FY2035 as rail new-build gives way to the EMU overhaul cycle and emerging equipment matures. Owner EBITDA margin flat at 21.0%: mix shift toward lower-gross-margin emerging equipment offsets opex leverage. Capex 11% -> 7% as the two power-device fabs complete (CNY ~2.7bn of budget left); D&A ex-ROU rises to 5.6% as they depreciate, so terminal capex/D&A is 1.25x. Working capital absorbs 30% of each year's revenue increase (FY2023-25 ran 30-50%). Cash tax 13% -> 15% as R&D super-deductions normalise. Terminal 2.5% CNY nominal growth, 15x cap (Gordon at 9.5%/2.5% is 14.6x, so Gordon binds).

bull.narrative: Rail FAI stays near the 2025 record (CNY 901.5bn) with the EMU Level-5 overhaul peak (~400 sets/yr) lifting aftermarket; the 8-inch SiC line wins import-substitution share against Infineon/Mitsubishi and the NEV power-module gap to BYD narrows; CRRC Group's record CNY 65bn export orders flow through to traction and the Indonesia drive base. Growth 10% fading to 3%; margin builds 150bp to 23% on fab utilisation and scale in semis; capex settles at 6.5% once the fabs are full; state customers' payment cycle improves so working capital absorbs only 25% of growth; cash tax stays near the 14% high-tech rate. Terminal 3.0%, 18x cap.

bear.narrative: The H1 2026 deceleration (Q2 revenue ~+3%) is the new run-rate: rail new-build slows further under the 15th Five-Year Plan, the emerging-equipment segment hits price competition from BYD Semiconductor, StarPower and Silan in IGBT/SiC and from PV-inverter overcapacity in new energy. Growth 3% then 2%; owner EBITDA margin erodes 300bp to 18% as semis pricing falls and fab depreciation (5.8% of revenue) lands on weaker volumes; capex never normalises below 10% because wide-bandgap technology demands continuous reinvestment; state customers stretch payment terms so working capital absorbs 40% of growth and receivables provisions rise; R&D super-deductions fade (cash tax 16%). Terminal 1.5%, 12x cap (cap binds). This is a weak-returns case, not a solvency case: net cash plus deposits of ~CNY 14bn cover every year of the path.

scenario_narratives.base: Rail transit (55% of revenue) grows mid-single digits on urban rail expansion and the EMU overhaul cycle while new high-speed-line construction stays well below its peak; emerging equipment (45%) grows low-double digits on power semiconductors, NEV electric drive and new-energy converters but at lower gross margin, holding the blended owner EBITDA margin at 21%. The investment thesis is a cash-conversion transition: three years of negative owner FCF end as the SiC/IGBT fab build-out completes (capex 14% -> 7% of revenue) and slower growth shrinks the receivables drag. Base IV lands near the A-share price; the H-share's 50%+ discount to it is the SOE/connected-party/receivables discount.
scenario_narratives.bull: Import substitution in power semiconductors and NEV share gains against BYD make emerging equipment a 25%+ grower for several more years while rail aftermarket peaks; fab utilisation lifts margins to 23%, capex falls to 6.5% and the working-capital cycle improves as state customers pay faster. Export orders (CRRC Group +38% in 2025) add a leg China-only models miss.
scenario_narratives.bear: Policy-directed rail capex rolls over, semis/new-energy pricing compresses margins to 18%, the fabs need perpetual reinvestment, and receivables from China State Railway Group and CRRC Group keep absorbing cash so owner FCF stays a fraction of profit. The business remains solvent and profitable on a ~CNY 14bn liquid pile, which is why the bear case still sits near today's price rather than far below it.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: owner FCF has been negative for three consecutive years, the H1 2026 print showed emerging-equipment growth stalling (Q2 revenue ~+3%, attributable profit +2.4% on revenue +7%), receivables plus bills plus contract assets exceed CNY 20bn against a state-customer base the company may not name, and governance runs through a controlling SOE parent under negotiated connected-transaction caps. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right: SiC share gains against BYD and the global incumbents, rail FAI holding its 2025 record, AND a shorter state-customer payment cycle. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY with the three adaptations this filer needs: interest and deposit income stripped from the flows and the ~CNY 14.5bn of cash, CDs, time deposits and structured deposits added back once in the bridge; leases charged as operating cost (not debt); NCI deducted once at book. The valuation is not about the current FCF, which is negative, but about whether the capex and working-capital drags that have consumed all of FY2023-25's CNY 11bn of profit normalise. The base case says they do over five years; the bear says only partly. The H share trades at a 52% discount to its own A share and on the 52-week low, so the finding is less 'cheap vs intrinsic value' than 'the H-share discount is the market's price for SOE governance and receivables risk, and even the bear case does not justify the current quote'.
key_risks_to_valuation: Receivables quality: AR 14.6bn + receivables financing 2.4bn + bills 2.7bn + contract assets 1.2bn (June 2026) against annual revenue of 28.7bn; a 10% impairment is ~CNY 2.1bn (CNY 1.6/share, HK$1.9) and is not in any scenario explicitly, only via the working-capital drag

Capex normalisation is the base case's single largest lever: holding capex at 14% of revenue in perpetuity rather than 7% removes roughly CNY 2bn/yr of terminal FCF, about 40% of base-case terminal value
Working-capital capture is estimated (-30% of revenue change) from three noisy years; the true structural rate could be -50% (FY2024) or improve with slower growth
Owner-EBITDA anchor of 21.3% strips interest and ~60M of investment income by estimate; the company does not publish an EBITDA ex-finance-income figure
fx_rate 1.1747 HKD/CNY is dated 2026-10-22; refresh_price.py moves the price but not the rate
Interim dividend CNY 0.46/share (CNY ~612M) may already have been paid by 2026-10-22, in which case the bridge is HK$0.54/share too generous
Export-control or sanctions escalation against a Chinese state-linked semiconductor and rail exporter is a tail risk not captured by the growth paths
The A-share price (CNY 47.42) is itself not a valuation anchor; STAR-Market A/H premiums of 100%+ are common and the H share has traded at this kind of discount for years
